role: The 16 colours plus bold, strikethrough, underline, italic, obfuscated and reset as section-sign formatting codes, with lookup maps and a code-stripping helper.
scope_reason: In scope: its formatting codes colour the chat lines and tooltips the native HUD draws (csrc/engine/chat.c splits coded parts; raster_hud.c tooltip_lines writes rarity codes).

members.name: BLACK..RESET
members.sig: the 22 enum constants, each with formattingCode, fancyStyling and controlString
members.note: static constants grouped: the enum (chatcomp.h CF_*), their codes (CF_CODE) and names (CF_NAME); controlString is chat_fmt_string

members.name: formattingCodeMapping
members.note: filled but never read by any method

members.name: formattingCodePattern
members.note: ported (csrc/engine/chat.c strip_codes, chat_split's colours-off path) but reached only with the chatColours option off, which only the chat options screen sets (client_cosmetic), and by a name tag's text (RendererLivingEntity; custom names need a named name tag, an anvil: world.conf anvil = off)

notes: Every S02 the server sends is compared per row: the oracle's rows carry each tick's S02s (Rows.s02: the IChatComponent.Serializer JSON and GuiNewChat's iterated parts) and test_snapshots and play --check compare csrc/engine/chatcomp.c chat_s02_check against the queue (lane/idxchat, DEVLOG 2026-09-27). The HUD's colour table for the codes is the font's (csrc/engine/font.c), the drawing GuiNewChat's and FontRenderer's records. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit).
